messages:
olivia: thinking about adding contextual hint cards to Console Analytics for routing/quota tweaks when telemetry shows regressions. idea: per-route suggestions with preview and apply flow. cc @samir @tara
samir: sounds useful. keep suggestions read-only unless explicitly applied. modal with diff + permission check is good.
ben w: detector can use median/p95 latency, token-cost delta, error-rate spike. need time window choice (1h/6h/24h). i like 6h as default.
tara: UX: show a short why + expected impact + confidence badge. example: 'route traffic -> model-x-quant gives ~30% cost down, +50ms latency'. include 'preview cost' CTA.
jia: cannot auto-apply by default. if we offer auto-rollout require canary + rollback and explicit opt-in per org. enforce RBAC: only platform owners/org admins.
ben w: proto suggestion payload example:
```
{
  "route": "/v1/chat/completions",
  "recommendation": "route_to_model",
  "target": "gptx-quant-v2",
  "reason": "p95 latency up 40% & token-cost spike",
  "expected_cost_delta_pct": -28
}
```
we can run offline sim on traces to produce expected delta + CI.
tara: where do saved queries fit? if user opens saved query 'payments-route' show hints scoped to that saved query. maybe show a badge when there are unread suggestions for that saved query.
samir: add a bulk-apply internal API for platform teams to push same suggestion across routes with similar signal. POST /internal/v1/route-suggestions/apply-bulk behind feature-flag + RBAC.
olivia: suggestion card fields: metric snapshot, suggestion json, expected cost delta, confidence, 'preview change' and 'apply suggestion' with audit trail. also sample traces link + 'replay traces' preview. avoid churn: only surface if persisted >2 windows OR confidence high.
jia: ops integration: when suggestion created create non-urgent ticket in #ops for review and tag telemetry. SRE can sign off before apply.
ben w: i'll prototype detector + sim cli: `./tools/sim-suggest --route /chat --window 6h`.
samir: api contract draft: {route, metric_snapshot, suggestion_id, recommendation_payload (json-string), confidence (low|med|high), suggested_by} -> response returns diff + dry_run_cost_estimate.
olivia: tradeoffs: prefer manual apply but give advanced teams an 'auto-rollout' opt-in with canary size, watch window, and rollback policy. also expose metric thresholds users can tweak.
deploy-bot: Deployer:sim-suggest v0.1 pushed to staging (build 2026.03.19-81).
olivia: next steps: tara wireframes for card + badge, samir finalize API, ben finish detector sim, jia specify ops/RBAC flow. sync friday 10am. thanks! :rocket:
